description: DB-VITALS (docs/operations/aws-revisao-arquitetura.md, finding 10): the share of service.db_disk_bytes the database may take before the live service alerts (platform.db.vitals alerts: disk, published to the platform's topic once when it starts and once when it ends). The database's size leaves out the write-ahead log and the temporary files, so the alert comes with room left: 0.7 of 20 GiB leaves 6 GiB.
